svg.data-asic: Broadcom Qumran2c BCM88820 with optional Broadcom OP2 BCM16K external TCAM (premium SKU only)
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO with optional holdover; SyncE (ITU-T); IEEE 1588v2 default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 (additional licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC; Time Sensitive Networking (TSN); Class C timing accuracy. NOS integration is required to activate these, which the datasheet states with an asterisk against the whole timing block
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations
svg.data-compliance-programme: IEEE 802.1CM fronthaul; ITU-T G.8273.2 T-BC Class C
svg.data-roles: C-RAN hub 5G fronthaul transport aggregation; backhaul aggregation for BBU pooling; programmable as a Broadband Network Gateway (BNG)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G QSFP28 SR4/LR4/ER4/ZR4, up to 80 km per the HIG port table
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR/ER; 10G SFP+ SR/LR/ER; 1G SFP SX/LX/EX - the same cages take all three speeds, and the HIG's port table rates ports 0-63 to 40 km
svg.data-timing-cables: the datasheet's Compatible Timing Cable Types row - 50 ohm SMA coaxial with a 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS; 50 ohm SMB coaxial with a 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz; shielded RJ45 for ToD. The accessory kit ships two SMB-to-BNC converter cables
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G on the two SFP+ management ports. The datasheet's Compatible Transceiver Types list is one list for the whole box and names no management-only part, so the speed here is the port list's ('2 x 10G SFP+ management ports')
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS SMA in; 1PPS SMB in/out; 10MHz SMB in/out; ToD RJ45 in/out
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 plus a micro-USB serial console
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 55024; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI; MTCTE; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A

circle.data-description: Present in HIG Figure 7 and given no table anywhere in this guide, so the states are the component default rather than a vocabulary borrowed from another platform

circle.data-states: off ok standby fail input-lost warning
circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no input power to all power supplies), Green (output on and OK), Blinking Green (standby state / only +5VSB on, or firmware updating), Red (critical event causing shutdown - failure, over current, short circuit, over voltage, fan failure, over temperature), Blinking Red (input power lost with a second supply in parallel still powered), Blinking between Green and Red (warning event, supply continues to operate - high temp, high power, high current, slow fan)
